test: the network as an aid to the additive baseline, not a stage in the path
log: LOOP 258 -- THE NETWORK AS AN AID, NOT A STAGE EVERYTHING MUST PASS THROUGH
Loop 256 forced every prediction through the network and it lost by -0.1517;
its LINEAR twin on identical inputs also lost, by -0.0494, so the framing was
wrong rather than the capacity. Here the baseline is the standing answer and the
network only proposes a correction, weighted by an alpha fitted on a held-out line.
DECLARED BEFORE THE RUN: fitting alpha makes a small gain nearly automatic, so J2
is machinery and NOT evidence. J3 -- real correction against its own row
permutation, same magnitudes, wrong pairing -- is the only gate that means anything.

J8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
J2 passing is not a result. A fitted blend weight buys a gain from any correction,
including the permuted one, and the permuted arm's own score is printed above so
that free lunch is visible rather than absorbed into a headline.
The network trains on SEVEN lines here, not eight, so it is slightly weaker than
loop 257's. That is the price of fitting alpha on a line it never saw.
Nine lines means the hypernetwork still generalises from seven examples; J7 is the
only thing standing between a positive and memorisation.
A stratum where the network helps names WHERE the interaction is learnable. It does
not name WHAT the interaction is, and nothing here recovers the mechanism loops
253 and 255 failed to find.
